composition_subtypes.role: sort sweets to enable smallest-k selection
recurrence on buffer to compute day-aware penalties

payload.core_composition_summary: Sorting ensures optimal subset, then 1D DP computes cumulative minimal penalty using a buffer representing day groups.
payload.rationale: The solution first sorts the array to enable greedy selection of the k smallest sweets, then uses a DP recurrence to efficiently compute the minimal penalty for each k.
